raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
dWise Healthcare IT Solutions Pvt Ltd. December 2023 - Present Software Engineer Bengaluru
As a Full Stack Developer, developed responsive Web Applications using Angular 15+ and implemented user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3 and TypeScript.
Designed and developed RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and worked with both SQL and NoSQL Databases.

Integrated Kafka for event-driven architecture and message queuing.
Designed and developed report templates using Jaspersoft Studio and integrated reports into web
applications for data visualization.
Participated in Code Reviews and provided constructive feedback.

Involved in Agile Model Procedure for Application Development.
Utilized Feign Client for seamless communication between microservices, simplifying HTTP requests and enhancing data transfer between distributed systems.
Demonstrated expertise in SQL queries by optimizing complex queries, creating efficient joins, and ensuring data integrity and performance in relational databases.
Managed dependencies and builds using Maven for streamlined development.
JSpiders Pvt Ltd. February 2023 - September 2023 Mern Full Stack Developer Intern | onsite Bengaluru
Developed dynamic, responsive web application using React, enhancing user experience by implementing state management and functional components for interactive interfaces.
Gained proficiency in Core Java for backend development and SQL for database management, optimizing queries and supporting database integration in projects.
raw_sections.projects:
Projects
Health Information System December 2023 - Present
Angular 15+, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Jasper Reports, Kafka, MongoDB, PrimeNg, SQL, Java
The HIS is designed to manage patient health records, offering healthcare providers a centralized platform for tracking, updating and accessing critical medical information across various specialties.
• The System consists of around 40+ distinct modules, each catering to specific healthcare functions such as
patient registration, appointment, billing, consultation etc. ensuring flexibility and scalability.
• By streamlining patient data management, the system enables healthcare professionals to provide timely,
informed decisions, improving overall patient care and treatment outcomes.
• By Implementing role-based accessibility for different user types such as doctors, nurses and patients, which
enabled secure and tailored web application experiences.
Dance Academy Web App July 2023 - September 2023
React JS, Sprig Boot, MySQL, HTML5, CSS, Java
Created a Dance Academy React Web Application with features for class schedules, Student registration and instructor management showcasing dynamic and responsive UI using React.

Integrated database operations with Mongo DB and MySQL, ensuring smooth data management and user interactions.

Implemented user authentication and role-based access control (admin, instructor, student), allowing secure access to personalized dashboards and managing different user privileges efficiently.
